annotation.query_order: annotation image order, then caption order; never sorted

inductive_scope: train_* bank construction/calibration only; test_full scan rows remain transductive controls
archive_role: metrics-only reference; no reconstruction, alignment, acceptance gate or routing retries

independence_guards.action: checked only; no resetting/reseeding or state replacement
checked only; no resetting/reseeding or state replacement

scoring.qg_and_bank_g: 0.5*(normalized text_global @ image_global.T + normalized text_TSE @ image_TSE.T), FP32
scoring.gg: 0.5*(image_global @ image_global.T + image_TSE @ image_TSE.T), SAME one-pass normalized gallery
scoring.view_prompt: if enabled, encode text separately for views 0/1 and select by gallery column view, including train texts
scoring.gallery_self_terms: retained for the unchanged S12 DualIS scan; no gallery-CSLS self-exclusion applied

formulas.CSLS/NNN: s - alpha * mean(topk(bank[:,g])); alpha=.5 is ranking-equivalent to 2s-r
formulas.DIS: IS if original query top1 is top1 of at least one bank query; otherwise unchanged s

corrections.dual_is_note: Rank-equivalent log of the product of two inverted softmax factors (DBNorm Eq.1). The requested fixed test gallery is used as gallery bank; the original paper uses train/validation gallery-bank features. This is an explicitly labelled test-gallery-bank adaptation. Self terms are retained. No test labels enter either bank penalty. The gallery can be fixed offline.
corrections.metric_ties: deterministic ascending gallery index; identical convention across all compared methods
